source_text.body:
Build a podcast-to-chatbot app and its marketing site
A poster used Replit Agent to build a full-stack app that turns podcasts into AI chatbots, plus a static marketing website.
·
Oct 1, 2025
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
What they did
The poster used Replit Agent to build CastBandit as a first full-stack app, covering front end, back end, database, and auth, so podcast owners could create chatbots trained on their episodes. They also imported partially built Astro site code from Bolt via GitHub into Replit’s General Agent, which ran the dev server and finished the static marketing site before they published it to Netlify.
How it went
They say both the app and marketing site worked, and Replit succeeded where Lovable and Bolt had stumbled on larger codebases and a homepage refactor. The biggest misses were costly rework from bad early schema choices, hallucinated API code, and a failed direct Stripe subscriptions integration later replaced with Autumn.
Worth knowing
Their main warning is cost: in one example, a hallucinated API path led to about $100 of debugging, and changing database IDs from serials to UUIDs later burned many more tokens and dollars.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
Build a full-stack web app that [turns podcasts/other source content] into an AI chatbot people can ask questions. Users should be able to [add a podcast by URL or upload a transcript] and then chat with answers grounded in that content. Also create a simple static marketing site with a headline, three features, and a sign-up link. You're done when both are running and I can try one full example.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/replit/comments/1nbwtm3
